title: DAO Wizard
tagline: DAO Wizard simplifies DAO creation and governance with AI-driven automation. Using AgentKit-powered Telegram bots and Gaia Lama as the LLM kit, it streamlines proposal management, user onboarding, and decision-making—making DAOs more accessible, efficient, and intuitive.
description:
DAO Wizard is an advanced AI-powered infrastructure platform designed to simplify the creation, management, and governance of Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs). Traditional DAOs often come with complex governance structures and intricate tokenomics, creating significant barriers to adoption. DAO Wizard removes these complexities by abstracting governance models and automating key processes, making it easier for individuals and organizations to launch and manage DAOs seamlessly. By integrating AI-driven automation and autonomous agents, DAO Wizard ensures that decentralized governance becomes intuitive, efficient, and accessible to a wider audience.

At the core of DAO Wizard's innovation is AgentKit, which powers AI-driven automation to enhance DAO workflows. Through a Telegram bot interface, users can create DAOs, register members, and manage governance operations without the need for deep technical expertise. AI agents handle proposal summarization, streamlining decision-making and reducing the cognitive load on DAO participants. Additionally, DAO Wizard employs Gaia Lama, a powerful large language model (LLM) kit within AgentKit, enabling users to interact with DAOs using natural language. By parsing user requests and generating structured insights, DAO Wizard ensures that governance operations are both intelligent and user-friendly.
To further enhance automation, DAO Wizard leverages CDP Kit for managing bot wallets, enabling seamless execution of financial operations within DAOs. With a no-code DAO setup, users can spin up a DAO in minutes without configuring complex governance models. 
DAO Wizard bridges Web2 and Web3 by making DAO participation more intuitive and inclusive. It eliminates the traditional entry barriers by allowing users to interact with decentralized governance through familiar interfaces and automated workflows. With AI-driven decision-making and seamless proposal execution, DAO Wizard represents the next evolution of decentralized governance. It envisions a future where DAOs operate autonomously, efficiently, and in a way that encourages broader participation in decentralized ecosystems.
how_its_made:
DAO Wizard is built using a combination of cutting-edge Web3 and AI technologies, seamlessly integrating decentralized infrastructure with AI-driven automation. At its core, the platform is powered by Solidity-based smart contracts, developed and tested using the Foundry framework, ensuring high efficiency, security, and modularity. These smart contracts handle essential DAO functionalities such as governance, membership, and tokenomics.

For the frontend, DAO Wizard employs Next.js and TypeScript, providing a highly responsive and dynamic interface for users to interact with their DAOs. The frontend is designed to be Web3-native, integrating Wagmi and Viem libraries to streamline blockchain interactions. Additionally, ConnectKit is used to enhance the wallet connection experience, ensuring smooth onboarding for users across different wallets. Smart contract interactions are facilitated using ethers.js, allowing seamless execution of DAO-related operations.

One of the most innovative aspects of DAO Wizard is its Telegram-based DAO workflow, which leverages AgentKit to automate governance tasks through AI-powered bots. These bots enable users to create DAOs, register members, and manage proposals directly from Telegram, making DAO interactions more accessible. To enhance user experience, DAO Wizard integrates Gaia Lama as an LLM (Large Language Model) kit within AgentKit, enabling natural language processing for parsing and interpreting user requests. This allows users to engage with DAOs effortlessly using intuitive, conversational commands.

We have used CDP Kit to create and manage the bot wallet, ensuring smooth execution of transactions within the Telegram-based DAO automation. This setup allows AI agents to securely handle on-chain interactions without requiring users to manually manage private keys or complex transactions.

A particularly hacky yet powerful aspect of DAO Wizard is its deep automation stack, where AI-driven agents dynamically interpret and execute governance actions, eliminating redundant manual tasks. By bridging traditional Web2 interfaces with Web3 automation, DAO Wizard redefines how DAOs are created and operated, making decentralized governance truly seamless, intelligent, and scalable.
